{{Quote|Well, if your plan had anticipated our only exit being blocked by about a million stormtroopers, I wouldn't have had to improvise.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Fallowan''' was undertaken in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==The mission==
Han used a [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] and Leia an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] uniform to infiltrate a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on [[Fallowan]]. The Princess managed to access and slice valuable data in Imperial computers.

[[File:Escape_form_Fallowan.jpg|thumb|left|160px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] escapes [[Fallowan]].]]

However they were discovered by a group of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] greasers in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] while they were leaving the base. They were surrounded by a large number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Solo decided to steal a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] to flee. Han and Leia were pursued by [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertanks]] and stormtroopers riding swoops. They were eventually rescued by Chewbacca in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Aftermath==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] escaped Fallowan and headed to the planet [[Cataalda]] in order to deliver the collected data. When they arrived on the planet, they discovered that the [[Cataalda outpost]] had been evacuated after having been found by an Imperial patrol.
